the last step of MRDP (recursively enumerable implies Diophantine) on top of Mathlib's Dioph

o-minimal structures and cell decomposition, Pila–Wilkie counting outside the algebraic part, and then independent Galois-orbit bounds and Ax–Lindemann/Ax–Schanuel functional transcendence before any André–Oort case

local systems from integral coefficient modules, comparison with sheaf cohomology, bounded finite projective models and the universal-coefficient spectral sequence
the Borel–Serre compactification: rational parabolic corners, manifolds with corners, nilmanifold-fibred strata with monodromy, and the stratification spectral sequence

the complete automorphic spectral decomposition, i.e. Eisenstein series and the residual spectrum (AutomorphicSpectralTheory AS.4), and the coarse/fine/invariant trace formula (AS.6)

judgements.reason: InductionRestriction needs only Brauer's induction theorem and characterization of characters, the cyclotomic splitting-field/Schur-index layer and Schur covers on top of a baseline that already has Rep.ind with both adjunctions plus TauCeti's Mackey, Clifford, Artin and SchurMultiplier files. CFSG still needs the triality-D4, Ree and Tits carriers with their characteristic-2/3 special isogenies, the pinned Chevalley-Demazure group schemes over Z and the isomorphism theorem for pinned groups for L5, and the A0 assembly.

CFSG's remaining work is a bounded set of carrier constructions (triality, short-root G2/F4 with their special isogenies, the pinned Chevalley-Demazure identification and the A0 assembly) on top of TauCeti's existing Index, TypeA-E7, Suzuki and 26-presentation files. Logic must build valued-field languages with Ax-Kochen-Ershov/Denef-Pas elimination, p-adic cell decomposition and definable integration, motivic integration on top of absent mixed motives and stacks, and a separate o-minimality/Pila-Wilkie/Andre-Oort branch, with nothing beyond Mathlib's ModelTheory in place.

Logic can state most of its targets directly on Mathlib's FirstOrder.Language, Ultraproduct.sentence_realize and Dioph, and its deep imports are mixed motives for LD.3 and functional transcendence for LD.6. ALSS cannot state anything until adelic reductive groups with reduction theory, Cartan involutions and symmetric spaces, local systems, and the Borel-Serre compactification exist, and then stacks derived Hecke correspondences, the boundary triangle and manifold-with-corners Verdier duality on an absent EnhancedDerivedSheaves foundation, with AS.5 and CC.2/CC.4/CC.7 reexports above that.

Drinfeld builds nine stages from scratch but on a partly present base (SkewPolynomial for L{tau}, FqtInfty, TauCeti's function-field Riemann-Roch) and imports only function-field arithmetic and SchemeAndStackFoundations SF.1/SF.2/SF.4. ALSS has no relevant baseline beyond manifolds and SL2 arithmetic subgroups, must build adelic reduction theory, symmetric spaces and Borel-Serre before its targets are even stateable, and additionally imports EnhancedDerivedSheaves E1, AutomorphicSpectralTheory AS.5 and CompletedCohomologyPartII CC.2/CC.4/CC.7.

EffectiveDiophantine's core descent and S-unit targets sit on TauCeti's existing Mordell-Weil, 2-Selmer and Neron-Tate height machinery, with LLL, Baker-Matveev bounds, Coleman integration and quadratic Chabauty as the genuinely new tail. Drinfeld has literally no object in the baseline: additive polynomials and Drinfeld modules, finite-flat torsion and Tate modules, the C_infinity exponential and lattice functor, moduli stacks with Pink's Satake compactification, t-motives, Taguchi's Tate theorem, Taelman's class-number formula and Papanikolas' Tannakian transcendence must all be built in sequence.

EffectiveDiophantine reuses TauCeti's Mordell-Weil, Selmer and height machinery and adds LLL, Baker-Matveev, Coleman integration and quadratic Chabauty. AdicEtaleGeometry must first turn TauCeti's Spa/Huber-pair set-level development into sheafy adic spaces with completed tensor products, then build the etale and pro-etale sites of adic spaces, and it imports perfectoid spaces entirely (almost purity and tilting P3, finite-stage etale descent P5/P6, closed quotients Q4), none of which exists, before A3's pseudocoherent-module and nonarchimedean perturbation milestone.

AdicEtaleGeometry has a real head start (TauCeti's Huber rings, Spa, rational subsets, localization and structure presheaf) and five stages above the missing perfectoid layer. CompletedCohomologyPartII takes all of ArithmeticLocallySymmetricSpaces ALS.0-ALS.5 (symmetric spaces, Borel-Serre, Hecke complexes, finite-level duality) as input, adds the absent smooth representation category SR.0 and Iwasawa algebras L1 and continuous duality D7, and only then builds its own nine stages of completion, derived limits, completed homology, finite-projective tower models and admissibility.

CompletedCohomologyPartII stacks completed-cohomology machinery on ALSS plus Iwasawa algebras and smooth representations. EtaleDuality must first import a six-roadmap etale foundation that does not exist at all (constructible coefficients, proper/smooth base change, Nagata compactification and Rf_!, l-adic realization, trace formula) on a stable enhancement Mathlib lacks, then build f^!, Verdier duality, purity, cycle classes, the perverse t-structure and IC, and finally EDC.7's decomposition theorem and relative hard Lefschetz on top of Weil II (DWP.7-9).

GL2's missing theory transitively contains EtaleDuality's: its R17.2 imports the fundamental lemma (ET.3), whose proof consumes exactly EDC.7's pure intersection complexes and decomposition theorem. On top of that GL2 still needs the whole smooth-representation category SR.0-SR.5, local factors AL.0-AL.3, local Langlands for GL_m (ET.6), the automorphic spectral decomposition (AS.4) and the invariant trace formula (AS.6), before its own twelve stages ending at Jacquet-Langlands, solvable base change and Langlands-Tunnell.

PELModuli needs polarized abelian schemes over a base, algebraic spaces/stacks with Artin representability, and Shimura data and canonical models before its moduli functors and smoothness theorem; that is a long but classical stack. GL2 needs all of that kind of depth plus the invariant trace formula, transfer factors and the fundamental lemma, local Langlands for GL_m and the full automorphic spectral decomposition, none of which has any baseline support beyond adele rings and abstract Hecke rings.

PELModuli's stack is abelian schemes, algebraic spaces/stacks and Shimura canonical models, and TauCeti already has abelian varieties over a field and polarized Hodge structures to build from. WeightsInEtaleCohomology's own stages are thin adapters over theory that is entirely absent: DWP.0-DWP.10 (Weil numbers, Weil I, the Weil II direct-image theorem, mixed complexes, absolute hard Lefschetz), LPV.0-LPV.7 (nearby/vanishing cycles, Picard-Lefschetz, pencil existence, symplectic monodromy) and EDC.0-EDC.5 beneath them, with Mathlib offering only a bare definition of l-adic cohomology on the pro-etale site.

Both sit on the absent etale/realization machinery, but Weights stops at the Weil I/Weil II/hard-Lefschetz tower plus its eigenform and Kuga-Sato applications. Periods additionally needs mixed motives with motivic Galois groups, Nori's period torsor, algebraic K-theory as spectra with Borel/elliptic/motivic regulators, Poitou-Tate and integral determinant lines, noncommutative Iwasawa reduced norms for ETNC, rank-zero/one BSD certificates, and the mixed-Tate coaction for multiple zeta values.

RefinedTrace's foundation gap is deeper per layer (Mathlib has SSet.Quasicategory and nothing else, so spectra, stable infinity-categories, Hochschild homology, THH and cyclotomic structure must all precede TC, AMMN and Wagner). But Periods needs that same spectral foundation for its K-theory and regulator inputs and adds mixed motives and realizations, Nori periods, Poitou-Tate and integral fundamental lines, noncommutative Iwasawa and ETNC, rank-zero/one BSD, polylogarithms, automorphic local factors and the mixed-Tate MZV coaction on top of it.

CompletedCohomologyPartII builds on absent but classical geometry and algebra (ALSS's symmetric spaces and Borel-Serre, Iwasawa algebras, smooth representations) and Mathlib already supplies group and continuous cohomology to start from. RefinedTrace has no baseline at all beneath it: spectra and stable infinity-categories, Waldhausen K-theory, Hochschild and cyclic homology, THH with its cyclotomic structure, TC and the cyclotomic trace, then prismatic cohomology, A_inf and Habiro rings before the AMMN square and Wagner's comparisons.

CFSG's index layer, all 26 sporadic presentations and the type A-E7, Suzuki and Geck-carrier Group definitions are already in TauCeti; what remains is the triality and Ree/Tits carriers, the pinned Chevalley-Demazure identification and the A0 assembly. Drinfeld has no Drinfeld module, Carlitz module, C_infinity, t-motive, elliptic sheaf or moduli stack anywhere in the baseline, and must stack nine layers from additive polynomials up to Taelman's class-number formula and Papanikolas' Tannakian transcendence.

Both have a deep tail (Baker-Matveev bounds, Coleman integration and quadratic Chabauty on one side; motivic integration and Andre-Oort on the other), but EffectiveDiophantine's descent, saturation and S-unit targets rest on TauCeti's existing Mordell-Weil, 2-Selmer and Neron-Tate height files. Logic must build valued-field languages with Denef-Pas elimination, p-adic cell decomposition and definable measures, then Grothendieck rings and motivic integration on top of the absent mixed-motive category MC.4 and stacks SF.1, and separately o-minimal cell decomposition, Pila-Wilkie, Ax-Schanuel and Galois-orbit bounds.

PEL needs abelian schemes with Rosati and Weil pairings, algebraic spaces with Artin representability, and Shimura data with canonical models, but TauCeti's abelian varieties, isogenies and polarized Hodge structures give it a starting point and its five prerequisite roadmaps are all algebro-geometric. ALSS has essentially no baseline (SL2 arithmetic subgroups and abstract Hecke cosets only), must build adelic reduction theory, symmetric spaces and the Borel-Serre compactification before any statement, and additionally imports EnhancedDerivedSheaves E1, AutomorphicSpectralTheory AS.5 and CompletedCohomologyPartII CC.2/CC.4/CC.7.

EtaleDuality owns a single enormous body: the etale six functors, Verdier duality, cycle classes, the perverse t-structure and the decomposition theorem over Weil II, on a stable enhancement Mathlib lacks. Periods needs the etale realization and cycle classes too, inside MotivesAndAlgebraicCycles MC.2/MC.4, and then adds motivic Galois groups and Nori's period torsor, K-theory spectra with Borel/elliptic regulators, Poitou-Tate and integral fundamental lines, noncommutative Iwasawa and ETNC, BSD rank zero/one, and the mixed-Tate MZV layer.

RefinedTrace's bottom layer is missing outright (no spectra or stable infinity-categories in Mathlib) and it stacks THH, cyclotomic structure, TC, prismatic and Habiro above it. GL2's stack is comparably tall but wider: it needs the whole smooth-representation and local-factor apparatus, local Langlands for GL_m, Eisenstein/spectral decomposition and Arthur's invariant trace formula, and the fundamental lemma, whose own proof consumes the perverse-sheaf and decomposition machinery that is itself absent, before its twelve stages up to Langlands-Tunnell.

AdicEtale's five stages sit on TauCeti's substantial Spa/Huber development plus the missing perfectoid layer. Weights imports theory of which nothing exists: the constructible etale coefficient categories, Rf_! and the trace formula, then EDC.0-EDC.5's duality, cycle classes and perverse category, then LPV's vanishing cycles, Lefschetz pencils and symplectic monodromy, and finally Deligne's Weil I, Weil II and absolute hard Lefschetz, before its own purity applications.

CompletedCohomologyPartII is tall but narrow: ALSS's symmetric spaces and Borel-Serre, plus smooth representations, Iwasawa algebras and continuous duality, then nine stages of completion, derived limits and admissibility. Periods draws on more than a dozen absent bodies at once — mixed motives with realizations and motivic Galois groups, Nori's period torsor, K-theory spectra with Borel and elliptic regulators, Poitou-Tate determinant lines, noncommutative Iwasawa reduced norms and ETNC, rank-zero/one BSD, crystalline interfaces, polylogarithms and mixed-Tate MZVs.

EffectiveDiophantine adds LLL, Baker-Matveev bounds, Coleman integration and quadratic Chabauty to TauCeti's existing Mordell-Weil, Selmer and height machinery. GL2 has to build the smooth representation category of p-adic groups, Whittaker models and local factors, local Langlands for GL_m, the automorphic spectral decomposition and Arthur's invariant trace formula, transfer factors and the fundamental lemma, before Jacquet-Langlands, solvable base change and Langlands-Tunnell can even be stated.

AdicEtale needs perfectoid spaces with almost purity and tilting plus A3's pseudocoherent-module milestone, but starts from TauCeti's Huber rings, Spa, rational subsets, localization and structure presheaf, and owns only five stages. ALSS starts from nothing relevant, must build adelic reduction theory, Cartan involutions and symmetric spaces, local systems, the Borel-Serre compactification, derived Hecke correspondences and manifold-with-corners duality in sequence, and imports EnhancedDerivedSheaves E1, AutomorphicSpectralTheory AS.5 and CompletedCohomologyPartII CC.2/CC.4/CC.7 on top.

Weights imports an enormous but categorically well-supported stack: Mathlib already has Grothendieck topologies, sheaf cohomology, derived categories and t-structures, and even a definition of l-adic cohomology, so the work is the etale six functors, cycle classes, perverse sheaves and Weil I/II above them. RefinedTrace has no foundation at all — no spectra, no stable infinity-categories, no Hochschild complex — and must build spectra, THH with its cyclotomic structure, TC and the trace, then prismatic cohomology and Habiro rings, before AMMN's Beilinson square and Wagner's q-Hodge and Habiro comparisons.
